title: Database connection saturation
summary: Connection pool exhaustion on the primary database cascaded into API latency and error spikes, amplified by client retries. Mitigation raised the connection limit and reaped idle connections.

events.message: Deploy api@1.9.4 (routine release, unrelated to incident)
Retry amplification detected: client retries at 3x baseline
db.connections at limit; new connections queued
E. Ramos identified connection pool exhaustion on db-primary
Terminated 34 idle connections older than 10 minutes
Connection pressure nominal; monitoring for recurrence
INC-2041 resolved: latency and error rate back to baseline
